title: Dimension-shifting acyclicity criterion from epimorphic images of quotients
statement: Let C and D be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian], with injective resolutions in C [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Let F : C → D be an additive left exact functor, expressed in Lean by F.Additive and PreservesFiniteLimits F [def-sp-left-exact-additive]. Let P be a property of objects of C. Assume (1) every injective object I satisfies P; (2) for every short exact sequence 0 → X₁ → X₂ → X₃ → 0, P(X₁) and P(X₂) imply P(X₃), so P is closed under these cokernels of monomorphisms; and (3) for every such short exact sequence with P(X₁), F sends its quotient map X₂ → X₃ to an epimorphism, without requiring P(X₂) or P(X₃) for this hypothesis. Then every object A satisfying P is F-acyclic [def-sp-acyclic]: for each q : ℕ, (R^(q+1) F)(A) is zero.

source.place: Lines 316–353, especially theorem CategoryTheory.Functor.rightAcyclic_of_epi_map_g at line 329 and its preceding criterion docstring.

proof.text: For any A in P, choose a monomorphism A → I with I injective and let Q be its cokernel. This is a short exact sequence. The injective hypothesis gives P(I), and the cokernel hypothesis gives P(Q). An injective object has a resolution concentrated in degree zero, so every positive right derived functor vanishes on I.

Use the long exact sequence for 0 → A → I → Q → 0. In degree zero, identify R⁰F with F by left exactness. The hypothesis makes F(I) → F(Q) epimorphic, and R¹F(I) = 0, so exactness forces R¹F(A) = 0. For the induction step, assume R^(q+1)F vanishes on every object in P, hence on Q. Exactness of R^(q+1)F(Q) → R^(q+2)F(A) → R^(q+2)F(I), whose outer objects are zero, forces R^(q+2)F(A) = 0. Induction proves F.rightAcyclic A. These are precisely the existing source proof’s base and successor cases.

proof_origin.place: Lines 316–353, especially theorem CategoryTheory.Functor.rightAcyclic_of_epi_map_g at line 329 and its preceding criterion docstring.
proof_origin.note: Attached existing proved declaration; no new Lean declaration or proof hole. The source proof embeds A into an injective I and sets Q = coker(A → I), which belongs to P. For R¹F(A), the epimorphism F(I) → F(Q), the degree-zero identification R⁰F ≅ F, and the long exact sequence give zero. Inductively R^(q+1)F(Q) is zero by the induction hypothesis, and R^(q+2)F(I) is zero by injectivity; exactness gives R^(q+2)F(A) = 0.

variable {C D : Type*} [Category* C] [Category* D] [Abelian C] [HasInjectiveResolutions C]
  [Abelian D] (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits F]

theorem rightAcyclic_of_epi_map_g (P : ObjectProperty C) (hinj : ∀ (I : C) [Injective I], P I)
    (hX₃ : ∀ S : ShortComplex C, S.ShortExact → P S.X₁ → P S.X₂ → P S.X₃)
    (hepi : ∀ S : ShortComplex C, S.ShortExact → P S.X₁ → Epi (F.map S.g)) {A : C}
    (hA : P A) : F.rightAcyclic A
